packageRules.description: Descope SDK packages are never auto-merged and get their own pull request: the adapter tells an outage from a bad token by the shape of the SDK's errors. Run `bun run test` and check packages/adapters/auth-descope/test/contract.test.ts (the SDK contract tests) before merging.
prBodyNotes: Run the contract tests in packages/adapters/auth-descope/test/contract.test.ts: they show any change in the SDK's error shapes.
